item.title: Show HN: Clipboard Sync – Share a clipboard, mouse and keyboard on your LAN
item.summary: Hi HN — I made Clipboard Sync, an opensource native app for sharing text, images, and selected files between macOS, Windows, and Linux machines on the same LAN. It can also share one mouse and keyboard across those computers. The source is available at: https://github.com/qiudaomao/clipboardSync Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49206081 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
